hero.headline: Bunty is your personal assistant on a phone call or WhatsApp.
hero.subtext: Set reminders, send messages, make calls, book appointments, order food. No app to download. Works in Hindi, English, Hinglish and Gujarati.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.desc: Tell Bunty to remind you about anything, at any time. It confirms on WhatsApp when the reminder is set and again when it is due.

messages.name: Messages and calls
messages.desc: Ask Bunty to send a message or make a call to someone in your contacts. Bunty reads back what it will send, and waits for your "yes".

appointments.name: Appointments
appointments.desc: Tell Bunty to book an appointment. It calls the place, finds a time, and confirms with you before booking.

food.name: Food orders
food.desc: Tell Bunty what you want to eat. It finds options, reads them to you, and places the order after you say yes.

google.name: Gmail and Calendar
google.desc: Bunty reads your new emails, replies on your behalf, and adds events to your Google Calendar. Requires one-time Google sign-in through Composio.

s1.title: You ask by call or WhatsApp.
s1.desc: Tell Bunty what you need, in your own words, in any of the four supported languages.

s2.title: Bunty reads it back.
s2.desc: Before doing anything, Bunty repeats what it understood and asks you to confirm.

s3.title: You say yes.
s3.desc: Nothing happens until you agree. Bunty never books, calls, messages or spends money on its own.

s4.title: Bunty does it and confirms on WhatsApp.
s4.desc: Once it is done, you get a confirmation message on WhatsApp with the details.

languages.heading: Works in your language
languages.note: Bunty picks up your language from your first words. No settings to change.

ask.title: Bunty always asks first.
ask.desc: Before it books, calls, messages or spends money, Bunty reads the task back and waits for your clear "yes".

payments.title: Payments are yours to approve.
payments.desc: Bunty never moves money on its own. When a payment is needed, you get a payment request and approve it with your own UPI PIN, in your UPI app or in WhatsApp.

calls.title: Calls on your behalf are honest.
calls.desc: When Bunty calls someone for you, it says it is an AI calling on your behalf.

external.title: Outside text is information, not instructions.
external.desc: Emails, web pages and what someone says on a call are treated as information for you. Bunty does not follow instructions from those sources.

data.title: Your data belongs to you.
data.desc: Recordings and data use need your consent, saved with the time. Say "delete my data" and everything is removed.

cta.heading: Start now
cta.note: Bunty asks for a one-time code sent to your number, your name, and your consent. That is all. Nothing is typed on this website.
